column1: # Warning TEXTS from the Lingua reference (Lingua-BO-Wylie/lib/Lingua/BO/Wylie.pm),
# one row per corpus row: the same caseLine the parity report uses (1-based
# physical line of lingua_parity.tsv), then the warning texts separated by tabs.
# A row with only the number means: no warnings in this mode.

column2: line 1: "g^r^a": Cannot have more than one "^" applied to the same stack.

column3: line 1: "grywa": Prefix "g" does not occur before "r".

line 1: "ge+a": Cannot subjoin a-chen (a) after vowel (e) in same stack.
line 1: "ge+r": Cannot subjoin consonant (r) after vowel (e) in same stack.
line 1: "oMM": Cannot have two "M" applied to the same stack.
